def klein_nishina_dsigma_dOmega(E, theta):
    """
    Klein-Nishina differential cross section dσ/dΩ (in cm^2/sr) per electron
    E: incident photon energy in MeV
    theta: scattering angle in radians
    """
    alpha = E / m_e_c2
    cos_theta = np.cos(theta)
    # Energy of scattered photon

    P = (E_prime / E)**2 * (E_prime/E + E/E_prime - np.sin(theta)**2)
